properties.name: A retirement carried out stops being reported as drift: `DriftKind::ExpectedAbsence` is added, and `reconcile_artifacts` reads `is_discontinued` on the missing-file path so an accepted OBSOLETES decision turns a `high` failure into a `low` note. A distinct kind rather than silence, following ExpectedChange's precedent — a file deleted by accident after an unrelated retirement must still be visible.
